notes: The Vesper Bell, cracked and without its tongue. Dot repeats what her gran told her, in dot-sleeping-ox.
text: There's a bell up at the priory, cracked clean through. Used to ring every sunset. My gran said the night it didn't ring, the monks all went for a walk.

followUp.text: Cracked clean through. Gran would be unbearable about it. She was always right about bells.
